tools.name: get_quickstart
tools.description: Ready-to-paste code to embed Proof of Type Input (a text box that proves a human typed the text, not AI) and verify its proof on the server. Pick a framework.

tools.name: verify_proof
tools.description: Verify a Proof of Type proof token (EdDSA JWT). Pass the text and your site origin to confirm the proof is for exactly that text on that site. Returns who typed it, when, and the human score.

tools.name: explain
tools.description: How Proof of Type Input works, what a proof guarantees and what it does not, privacy, limits, the proof token claims, and the SDK options and events.
